name: Frank (level analyst)
sounds_like: Mid male at 115 Hz with a deliberately narrow 6.9-semitone range - it stays level, barely inflecting, which reads as considered rather than flat. Slow: 4.5 onsets per second of speech, among the least hurried in the library. Pauses up to 1.0s between thoughts. Mid timbre (centroid 1511 Hz), clean. 24.1s of measured analytical prose about a product launch.
casts_well_as: Documentary voiceover, analyst, journalist, expert witness, corporate or explainer narration, anyone laying out facts in order.
avoid_for: Emotional peaks, comedy, urgency, or argument. The narrow pitch range that makes it credible also makes it refuse to spike.
note: Byte-identical to voices_examples/vibevoice/en-Frank_man.wav. Pairs well against male_03_carter when a scene needs a measured voice answering a warm one.
